answer: Rotating ciphers stop sybil farms. (1) Each epoch a cipher is keyed to the agent's last five receipts. (2) The agent decrypts it and attaches the plaintext to its bid; a wrong answer voids it. (3) New accounts cannot derive the key, so they first finish 5 verified jobs under a 10-token bond. (4) Forged receipts are checked against ledgers; one mismatch burns the bond and bars the key. A 1,000 fake farm must buy 5,000 jobs at $2, $10,000 plus 10,000 tokens in bonds; one honest agent risks a refundable deposit. A falcon answers only its handler across tundra; a copied cipher fools no one.
